added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no baseline_suite or after_suite gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: `_validate_focus` now resolves a focus array segment through `MEMBER_OF` with its own Cypher (imas_codex/cli/discover/signals.py:77-84) that duplicates the segment-resolution rule `build_focus_predicate` owns (imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:534-537); the docstring calls it "the same path `build_focus_predicate` resolves it", so the two are a hand-maintained mirror with no shared owner, and a future change to the predicate's resolution leaves validation silently disagreeing again — the exact Class of defect this node exists to close.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified 2 production call site(s): imas_codex/cli/discover/sequence.py:424 dispatches run_signals_stage, and imas_codex/cli/discover/signals.py:115 (run_signals_stage) calls _validate_focus.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against the base 9f4bf1d3; the single commit 997941042 splits _validate_focus's one query into an id/accessor query and a MEMBER_OF segment query (signals.py), replaces the two stale stage tests with tests of the new refusal and the focus_items pass-through plus three more, and adds the graph-marked predicate test and the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/cli/test_discover_signals_stage.py passing at the merged head with the new refusal and the pass-through, then validation resolving array segments exactly as the predicate and a graph-marked test selecting the MDAC magPbTCNNN members; the manifest records stage_tests.log (17 passed, EXIT=0), graph_tests.log (1 passed, EXIT=0) and a non-zero-EXIT negative control.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to replace the two stale 'claim query takes no item filter' stage tests with tests of what the stage now does, and to make _validate_focus resolve a data_source_path array segment exactly as build_focus_predicate does, pinning the predicate with a graph-marked test.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records both gate commands with EXIT=0 and their summary lines, test_logs naming stage_tests.log and graph_tests.log, and negative_control_log naming negative_control.log whose last line is EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares imas_codex/cli/discover/signals.py, tests/cli/test_discover_signals_stage.py, tests/discovery/test_signals_focus_graph.py and the evidence fragment (plus a docs/figures directory); git show --stat 997941042 lists exactly those four files.

justifications.durability: test_validate_focus_refuses_a_sourceless_signal_carrying_the_segment reddens (DID NOT RAISE) when the MEMBER_OF join is dropped, shown in negative_control.log (1 failed, 16 passed, EXIT=1), and the graph-marked test_rendered_predicate_selects_the_named_source_members guards the predicate validation now mirrors; docked one point because the stage tests drive a fake GraphClient that branches on the Cypher text ('MEMBER_OF' in cypher), so a query rewrite that preserved the defect could pass the mock.
justifications.evidence: the done-when's gate is tests/cli/test_discover_signals_stage.py; the manifest records 17 passed EXIT=0 and stage_tests.log holds the summary line, the graph arm's graph_tests.log holds '1 passed' EXIT=0, and I reproduced both at the reviewed head (17 passed in 6.07s; 1 passed in 7.18s).
justifications.fit: the change edits an existing per-stage private helper and mirrors its neighbour's idiom; no version, plan, sprint or ticket identifier and no attribution appear in the changed names, which describe mechanism (_validate_focus, segment_rows) as the surrounding imas_codex/cli/discover/ modules do.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/cli/discover/signals.py:77-84 now resolves a segment only through a segment_rows query that joins MEMBER_OF, matching imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:534-537, and the replaced tests assert the new refusal and the focus_items pass-through, so validation now agrees with the claim.
justifications.reuse: the change does not add a new definition, but it re-implements the predicate's segment-through-MEMBER_OF resolution as a second Cypher query (signals.py:77-84) instead of extending build_focus_predicate (parallel.py:516), so the capability has a hand-maintained mirror rather than one owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat 997941042 lists only imas_codex/cli/discover/signals.py, tests/cli/test_discover_signals_stage.py, tests/discovery/test_signals_focus_graph.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the manifest's declared write paths.
